d:
Saudi Arabia pulled off a MASSIVE upset against China in the FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers!
In an incredible battle during Window 5, Saudi Arabia fought until the very end and secured a thrilling 82-80 victory over China!
Mohammed Alsuwailem was UNSTOPPABLE, putting on a monster performance with 30 POINTS and leading Saudi Arabia to one of the biggest wins in their qualifying campaign!
China came into the game as one of the top teams in Group F, but Saudi Arabia had other plans!
A HUGE win, an INSANE performance and a moment Saudi basketball fans will never forget!
